name: Wireless Communications
description: Overview of modern wireless communications. Conventional wireless access system design and wireless communication principles. Mobile radio propagation: link budgeting, large scale path loss and shadowing. Statistical multipath channels and small-scale fading. Diversity techniques, adaptive modulation and coding. Multicarrier modulation, spread spectrum, shared spectrum usage. Wireless resource allocation and optimizations. Physical layer aware cross-layer optimization concepts. Learning-aided optimizations.
